quotes.text: Once you see identity as part of your growth infrastructure, the perimeter model stops looking old. It starts looking expensive.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Reframes identity from a security cost to growth infrastructure.

quotes.text: That is the move from account-centric identity to claim-centric identity. In the old approach, the account is the asset.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Names the core architectural shift behind portable identity.

quotes.text: Governance does not disappear. It moves. The organization still defines issuance rules, trust rules, and acceptance rules.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Counters the misconception that decentralized identity means less governance.

quotes.text: The strength of Entra is not that it magically removes the hard work of governance. Its real value is that it gives you the places to enforce your policy once you actually know what that policy should be.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Sets realistic expectations of what Entra contributes to external identity governance.

quotes.text: Proof can move but accountability usually shouldn't and that is the design split leaders need to protect.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A memorable design principle for portable trust rollouts.

takeaways: External identity is shifting from account-centric to claim-centric: instead of rebuilding trust in every app, organizations verify portable proof against policy.
Entra External ID acts as the orchestration and policy layer for customers and partners, while Entra Verified ID adds portable proof through verifiable credentials.
Start with one costly external journey, consolidate identity orchestration, reduce friction with passkeys and just-in-time migration, then add portable proof and lifecycle governance.
hook: Customers, partners, contractors and AI agents no longer stay inside your perimeter, yet most identity stacks still rebuild trust with forms, passwords and duplicate accounts. This episode helps security architects and IT leaders see where Entra External ID and Verified ID fit in a claim-centric identity model. Learn how to cut sign-up friction, reduce support load and keep governance strong.
